app.tagline: Track shared expenses with a group and see who owes whom.

link.shareText: Join "{name}" on BillSplit to split expenses
link.inviteHelp: Share this link in your group chat. Anyone who opens it can sign in or create an account, then join this group.
link.ownerOnly: Only the group owner can share the invite link.
link.lockHelp: Nobody new can join while the group is locked. People already in it are not affected.
link.lockedHelp: This group is locked, so nobody new can join through this link.

signin.title: Sign in or create an account
signin.intro: Enter your email. We'll send you a sign-in link. New here? This creates your account.
signin.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on any device to continue.
signin.codeLabel: Or enter the 6-digit code from the email
signin.spam: No email after a minute? Check your spam folder.
signin.linkHelp: Tap the button to finish signing in on this device.

testLogin.title: Test sign-in
testLogin.intro: This is the staging site. Sign in as one of the test users.
testLogin.help: Pick a test user to sign in as. This only works on staging.

name.title: What's your name?
name.help: People in your groups will see this name.

groups.step2: Share the group link in your group chat.
groups.step3: Add expenses. BillSplit works out who owes whom.
groups.gotLink: Got a group link from a friend? Open it to join their group.
groups.toConfirm: 1 payment to confirm | {count} payments to confirm

newGroup.help: Next you'll get one link to share with everyone in the group.
newGroup.name: Group name

balances.title: Balances
balances.settleHelp: Tap “Pay” for the bank details and a QR code. A payment counts once the person receiving it confirms it.

share.help: Share this link in your group chat. Everyone who opens it can sign in and join {name}.

people.title: People
people.help: Add someone who won't use the app, or add people now so they can pick their name when they join.

settings.exportHelp: Download all expenses with each person's share.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the group owner can change these details.
settings.leaveHelp: Leaving keeps your expenses in the group.
settings.deleteHelp: Deleting removes the group and all expenses for everyone.
settings.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? You'll no longer see it. Your expenses stay in the group.
settings.deleteConfirm: This deletes the group and all its expenses for everyone. Type the group name to confirm:

expense.readOnly: Only the person who added this, the group owner or an admin can change it.
expense.splitCount: Split between 1 person. | Split between {count} people.
expense.titleRequired: Enter what the expense was for
expense.archived: This group is archived, so its expenses can't be changed.

invite.onList: Are you already on the list?
invite.deadHelp: Ask the group for the current link.
invite.lockedHelp: Nobody new can join it right now. Ask the group owner to unlock it.
invite.memberSignIn: Already in this group? Sign in

admin.title: Admin
admin.name: Name
admin.signinsHelp: Every sign-in request: whether the email was delivered and whether the person verified it.
admin.confirmHelp: The admin area needs a Cloudflare Access sign-in.

bank.title: Bank details
bank.help: People in your groups see these, so they can pay you back by bank transfer or by scanning a QR code. Only IBANs from SEPA countries in Europe work.
bank.bicHelp: Only some banks outside your country need it.
bank.ibanFormat: Enter an IBAN, such as BE71 0961 2345 6769
bank.ibanCountry: Only IBANs from SEPA countries (the EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland, among others) are supported
bank.ibanLength: This IBAN has the wrong number of characters for its country
bank.ibanChecksum: This IBAN isn't valid. Check it for typos.
bank.holderRequired: Enter the name on the account
bank.bicInvalid: Enter a BIC of 8 or 11 characters, such as GKCCBEBB, or leave it empty

settle.title: Pay {name}
settle.notOnApp: {name} doesn't use BillSplit, so there are no bank details to show. Pay them another way, then tap the button below.
settle.noBank: {name} hasn't added bank details yet. Ask how they'd like to be paid, then tap the button below once you've sent the money.
settle.notEuro: The QR code only works for transfers in euros. This group uses {currency}, so use the bank details below.
settle.scanHelp: In KBC, ING, Belfius, BNP Paribas Fortis and most other European banking apps, choose to scan a QR code, check the details and confirm.
settle.confirmNote: {name} will be asked to confirm the money arrived. It counts toward balances once they do.
settle.directNote: {name} doesn't use BillSplit, so it counts right away.
settle.scanOtherPhone: Scan it with your banking app on another phone.

payments.title: Payments in progress
payments.checkHelp: Check your bank account, then confirm the payments sent to you.
payments.recordReceivedConfirm: Record that {from} paid you {amount}? It counts toward balances right away.

person.noExpensesYou: You're not in any expenses yet.
person.viewExpensesYou: View your expense | View your {count} expenses

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.help: Receipts or invoices as a PDF or an image, up to 10 MB each.

archive.banner: This group is archived. You can still look at everything, but nothing can be changed.
archive.attachmentsKept: Attachments are removed after 90 days without activity.
archive.attachmentsRemoved: Attachments were removed after 90 days without activity.
archive.title: Archive
archive.help: Archiving keeps the group and all its expenses, but nobody can change them or join any more. Attachments are removed after 90 days without activity.
archive.notSettled: Everyone has to be settled up before you can archive the group.
archive.confirm: Archive this group? Nobody can add or change expenses until it is reopened.
archive.reopenHelp: Reopening lets people add and change expenses again.

overview.toConfirm: 1 payment to confirm | {count} payments to confirm
